department: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering (ME) and Faculty of Aerospace Engineering (AE)

deadline.value: No central deadline: apply to a specific advertised PhD position; each vacancy has its own deadline.
deadline.quote: To become a PhD candidate you can apply to a specific PhD position that can be found on our vacancy website.

also.quote: The Graduate School of the TU Delft Faculty Mechanical, Maritime and Materials Engineering (ME GS) operates under the umbrella of the TU Delft Graduate School

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You apply to a specific position and are employed in your supervisor's department; the application process includes a conversation with the professor.

also.quote: You are employed on a four-year contract at your supervisor’s department.

funding.value: Regular PhD positions are four-year employment contracts with a salary under the Dutch universities' collective labour agreement; if no position is available you must find your own scholarship or grant.
funding.quote: Regular PhD position | You are employed on a four-year contract at your supervisor’s department. | If there are no PhD positions available in your area of interest, you will have to find your own funding.

also.quote: If you are accepted for a PhD vacancy you will receive a salary in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for Dutch universities

entry_route.value: A Dutch master's degree or foreign equivalent in a field relevant to the PhD research.
entry_route.quote: Have a Dutch master’s degree (or a foreign equivalent)

also.quote: You have completed a Master’s degree in one of the fields relevant to PhD research.

notes: The ME Graduate School and the separate AE Graduate School (https://www.tudelft.nl/en/ae/research/ae-graduate-school/admission) both apply the university-wide admission rules; vacancies are filled by individual research groups.
